tool.description: Generate curated structural coverage and conservative end-to-end requirement proof reports for requirements, symbols, or grouped types. Use it to ask which requirements are tested end to end, how strong each requirement's evidence is (evidenceLevel: proved, tested, asserted or unverified), and what blocks the rest; use kb_find_gaps for a plain list of missing links and kb_check for rule violations. Reports include the compatible repair plan plus typed kibi.migration-plan.v2 actions; semantic and E2E actions remain review/execution work. Paginated plans identify incomplete scope and no mutation occurs.

by.description: Report shape: req (proof status and repair plan), symbol (ownership coverage) or type (counts per type).

includeMigrationPreview.description: Opt in to a deterministic, read-only kibi.legacy-migration-plan.v1 preview for ready semantic-inventory repair batches.

includePassing.description: Also return rows that are already tested or not applicable. By default only rows that still need repair are returned.

includeTransitive.description: Count symbol coverage reached transitively through linked entities, not only direct links.

kb.description: Optional KB dependency name from .kb/dependencies.json to read, at its pinned commit, instead of this project's KB.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. When the repair plan reports scope.complete false, rerun with offset 0 and a larger limit.

migrationLimit.description: Maximum requirement migration batches to preview. Defaults to one review batch.

migrationOffset.description: Zero-based offset into ready semantic-inventory batches.

migrationPredicateLimit.description: Maximum exact predicate-schema candidates retained per assertive proposition.

migrationPredicateMinScore.description: Minimum deterministic predicate-schema rank score retained in migration previews.

statuses.description: req mode: include only rows whose proofStatus is listed. The summary always covers the whole KB.

tags.description: Keep rows for entities carrying any of these metadata tags.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional absolute path of the workspace this call is about, such as your git worktree, when it is not the server's.

tool.name: kb_coverage
